caption: The drawing depicts a wooden tool consisting of a rectangular block with four long, pointed wooden spikes protruding vertically from its top surface. Attached perpendicularly to the block is a single handle, centered on the underside, which is rounded and tapers slightly at the end. On either side of the rectangular block, there are small cylindrical wooden pegs inserted horizontally through the shorter ends. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown, indicating a wood material, with the grain and texture of the wood clearly visible. The background is a plain off-white color, and there is a small printed name "WAYNE WHITE" beneath the object, aligned to the left.
title: Straw Rake
